answer: Identity Bond Decay stops bulk fakes: bonds earn no yield and decay, so only real workers can stay. A newcomer locks a 40-unit bond whose kernel value falls 2 units per epoch unless work refreshes it; each task restores it and adds one thread of history, while an idle bond erodes like a dune below the threshold. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 units plus 2,000 per epoch, more than fakes earn; an honest agent pays 40 once and stays topped up.
